# Anivora 0.1.32 — App homepage and direct downloads

- Profile Website now opens the new Anivora homepage at https://anivora-f5a.pages.dev/. The separate Android download page remains at /app/, and support moves to /support/. Privacy, terms, share pages and password-reset handoff remain available on Cloudflare.
- Refresh the profile footer with recognizable brand icons. Website and the public Anivora-Releases GitHub repository are active; unprepared Discord, Telegram, Instagram and Reddit links remain inactive without opening anything or showing setup alerts.
- Download Anivora now starts a direct download of the latest official signed ARM64 APK. A stable latest-APK asset is verified against the versioned APK in every public release. GitHub hosts the bytes; visitors do not need to browse GitHub or choose a file.
- On supported Android browsers, a verified website association lets the download page inspect Anivora’s installed version. Current/newer installations show Open Anivora only; outdated installations show Update Anivora and Open. If the browser, older APK or returned version does not support detection, the page keeps a download/update option available.
- Preserve horizontal remote avatar rows, Google profile photos, cached portrait loading, six bundled defaults, GitHub updates, direct manga providers and server-status notices. Avatar and APK bytes remain off Render.

Android version code: **34**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Existing signing certificate retained. Install over the existing app to keep local data.

Validation covers app/backend/static-site tests, TypeScript, lint, Expo compatibility and Expo Doctor; mobile/desktop homepage layouts, mobile navigation, direct download behavior, current/outdated/unknown installation states, unavailable metadata, support/legal pages, native association generation, Android emulator integration, and final APK signature/package/source/resource verification. Both the versioned and stable-alias public downloads are checked before updating the feed.

Browser detection uses navigator.getInstalledRelatedApps and is not universal. Older APKs without the reverse website association cannot be reliably detected. Browser tests use controlled installed-app metadata; physical Infinix Hot 50i/XOS detection and rendering have not been certified. Google console branding/homepage fields are not changed by deploying the website.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/e76a7bbe36eca18f644f0f150529ef9577a79e4a
